units.source_text: 而且，当时他还没决定夏季到哪儿去避暑，才想起是否要把家属带到这个温泉浴场来。

en.t: Moreover, at the time he had not yet decided where to go for the summer to escape the heat, and only then did he think of bringing his family to this hot spring resort.

units.source_text: 幸好她是个良家女子，如果能来，还可以给夫人作个好导游，说不定还可以向她学点舞蹈，借以消愁解闷。

en.t: Fortunately, she was a respectable young woman; if they came, she could serve as a good guide for his wife, and perhaps his wife could even learn a little dancing from her to relieve her boredom and gloom.

units.source_text: 他确实这样认真考虑过。

en.t: He had truly considered it seriously in that way.

units.source_text: 尽管他感到对女子存在着一种友情，他还是渡过了这友情的浅滩。

en.t: Although he felt that a kind of friendship existed toward the woman, he had still crossed the shallows of that friendship.
